title: Execution/Schedule 幂等键：手动 UUID、调度 Key 与离线上传不重复

cases.title: SYS-31 Manual Execution UUID 幂等
cases.canonical_before: NOT_RUN (repair build not executed; legacy baseline PASS excluded per remaining_dimensions)

description: Two manual Run Now calls each produced a distinct Hub-created Execution UUID (premise of the key).
The same manual Execution UUID was uploaded twice (duplicated EXECUTION_FINISHED frame) and the Hub kept exactly one row with unchanged terminal status.
Real Execution side effect observed: script stdout carried the nonce marker, terminal SUCCESS.

remaining_or_limitations: Duplicate upload was exercised via a harness frame proxy in front of the owned child Agent; no product source was modified.
The Agent-side dedup branch for a repeated RUN_EXECUTION dispatch (same UUID) was not forced; only the upload/idempotent-upsert direction was proven.

cases.title: SYS-32 Scheduled Execution Key 幂等
cases.canonical_before: NOT_RUN (repair build not executed; legacy baseline PASS excluded per remaining_dimensions)

description: Hub-owned: two distinct one_time Schedules sharing Task+Node+ScheduledTime produced exactly one Execution; a third Schedule with a different ScheduledTime produced its own Execution in the same pass.

Agent-owned: a one_time Schedule fired on the connected child Agent; after a real child Agent restart (in-memory fire maps lost) the same slot was re-attempted and suppressed, leaving one Hub row and one local journal row for that slot.

remaining_or_limitations: The Key is (TaskID, NodeID, ScheduledTime); Task Revision is intentionally not part of the key and was held constant here.
No cron/DST-boundary variants were exercised in this batch.

cases.title: INV-07 Execution ID / Key 必须幂等
cases.canonical_before: NOT_RUN (repair build not executed; legacy baseline PASS excluded per remaining_dimensions)

description: Manual path key = Hub-created Execution UUID; duplicate upload kept one row.
Schedule path key = TaskID+NodeID+ScheduledTime, enforced on the Hub scheduler and on the agent-owned scheduler (unique slot index + explicit slot lookup), surviving an Agent restart.
Offline path key = Execution ID on journal upload/ACK; re-upload kept one row and converged synced=true.

remaining_or_limitations: INV-07 is proven for the three idempotency paths exercised here (manual UUID, scheduled slot, offline upload); other Execution-producing paths (Application deploy/operation) were out of scope.

cases.title: SYS-15 离线 Execution 上传和 ACK 幂等，无重复
cases.canonical_before: NOT_RUN (repair build not executed; legacy baseline PASS excluded per remaining_dimensions)

description: Child Agent kept running while its Hub link was cut; the agent-owned allow_offline one_time Schedule fired locally and the journal recorded the Execution with offline=true, synced=false.
No Hub row existed while offline. On reconnect the Execution was uploaded and created on the Hub (offline=true).

The first EXECUTION_ACK was dropped, so the journal stayed synced=false; a real child Agent restart re-uploaded the same Execution ID, the Hub kept exactly one row, and the journal then converged to synced=true.

remaining_or_limitations: "Offline" was simulated by cutting the owned child Agent from the repair Hub through the harness frame proxy; the protected repair Agents and the Hub were never stopped.

cases.title: AR-20 Duplicate Execution Upload；恢复后幂等、持久化、Desired State 与实际状态一致
cases.canonical_before: NOT_RUN (repair build not executed; legacy baseline PASS excluded per remaining_dimensions)

description: Duplicate EXECUTION_FINISHED for one manual Execution UUID: Hub stored one row, no state rollback.
Duplicate upload after offline recovery: same Execution ID uploaded twice, Hub stored one row, terminal status and offline flag consistent, no half-state.
Agent-side journal persistence survived a real process restart; the recovered row is the exact same Execution ID.

remaining_or_limitations: Duplicate upload was injected at the frame layer of the harness proxy; the underlying Hub upsert/dedup logic is the unmodified product path.
